mub_theoretical_upper_bound.signature: pub fn mub_theoretical_upper_bound(dim: usize) -> Result<usize, MubConfigError>
mub_theoretical_upper_bound.obligation: Return exact dim+1 as Result for every usize except MAX, which returns UpperBoundOverflow. This arithmetic helper is not a dimension admission or basis construction. Its former infallible return type intentionally changes; the only local call was its updated unit test.

invariant_argument: MubOperatorConfiguration owns private dim and bundles with only shared accessors. new admits the modulus 2..=256 and count<=d+1 before seen-set construction. The local minimum error precedes provider rejection for d<2. Provider rejection now precedes count errors for d>256, so usize::MAX cannot reach dim+1.

Each bundle is checked for exactly d-1 points before membership checks. For each member, coordinate admission precedes identity exclusion then global duplicate detection. Unlike the old pair-only check this validates singleton d=2 bundles. A successful seen insertion proves distinctness both within a bundle and across all earlier bundles. Original ordering is preserved and no public mutator can forge the representation.

After member admission all i<j pairs are compared, with j+1 derived from enumerate and bundle length<=255. Antisymmetry and alternating form prove that testing each distinct pair once suffices for all ordered pairs including diagonal. Empty configurations are admitted; composite dimensions carry only the explicitly checked modular operator-bundle invariants. They do not assert existence of complete unbiased bases.

Global uniqueness means sequence lengths equal finite-set cardinalities d-1, bundle sets are pairwise disjoint, and excluded origin places their union inside the d*d-1 nonzero coordinate set. The actual Finset union cardinality theorem plus d>=2 proves the bound k<=d+1. is_complete is exactly equality to that bound, not a separate physical completeness theorem.

canonical_prime composes the reviewed Weyl generator with in-place retain on each owned ray buffer and ordinary new validation. Field isotropy and unique nonzero directions give p+1 disjoint bundles of size p-1. The constructor rechecks the public invariants. No redundant vector allocation is introduced by filtering: retain keeps the owned buffers, whose capacity may remain p rather than p-1.

mub_theoretical_upper_bound uses checked_add and a dedicated overflow error; its arithmetic domain includes 0 and 1 for backward value behavior. Its Result return type replaces the unsafe infallible helper; exact local import search finds only the updated source unit test, and new uses it after dimension admission. The model proves plus-one representability as strict comparison to a machine maximum. The full usize domain is tested at MAX and MAX-1 without wrapping or saturation.

The independent constructor oracle uses linear point membership and i128 determinants, rather than the production BTreeSet/provider helpers, for 13,498 small candidate executions at d=2,3. Separate witnesses cover singleton invalid coordinates, both size sides and error priority, duplicate/identity/noncommuting points, oversized dimension, cloned ownership, canonical primes up to 251 and admitted composite d=256 cases.

All 14 production bodies have structural maxima CCN 9, cognitive 5, nesting 2. Validation costs O(k*d squared) modular point operations and O(k*d log(k*d)) set insertions, with k<=d+1, d<=256; at most (d+1)*(d-1)<=65535 stored nonzero records are allowed by shape and no set is allocated before admission. Canonical construction additionally holds O(d squared) phase records and reuses ray buffers. The supplied caller-owned Vec allocation already exists and no allocation-free rejection of caller input is claimed.

Public failures expose no configuration, partially-filled seen set or partial canonical output; local ownership drops them. Shared borrowed bundle views and derived Clone preserve original admission. The private helper arguments rely on their described admitted callers; arbitrary helper misuse is not a public panic-freedom claim.

proof_correspondence.alternating: The determinant form on actual commutative-ring pairs vanishes on the diagonal, including composite modular rings.
proof_correspondence.antisymmetric: Swapping pair operands negates the exact determinant.
proof_correspondence.additive: Coordinatewise addition is additive in the determinant first argument.
proof_correspondence.ray_isotropic: Every two points of an actual projective field direction commute under the form.
proof_correspondence.unique_direction: Every nonzero point over a field has exactly one vertical/slope direction; admitted prime ZMod supplies that field.
proof_correspondence.distinct_directions_disjoint: Distinct field directions cannot share a nonzero point.
proof_correspondence.direction_count: A finite field has its cardinality plus one projective directions.
proof_correspondence.bundle_mass: Actual pairwise-disjoint finite bundles of size d-1 have union cardinality k*(d-1).
proof_correspondence.bundle_mass_bound: Global identity exclusion places that union in the d-squared-point ambient set minus one.
proof_correspondence.basis_count_bound: For d>=2 the actual mass inequality forces k<=d+1.
proof_correspondence.bounded_add: Representatives below d<=256 have a sum at most 510.
proof_correspondence.subtract_representative_safe: Adding d before subtracting a residue avoids unsigned underflow.
proof_correspondence.singleton_admission: Membership admission applies to singleton bundles even though no distinct pair exists.
proof_correspondence.bounded_plus_one: Exact dimension-plus-one representability is strict inequality against the machine maximum.
